\section[(dialogue)]{Animals and the body — a first pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R144-first-pass-animals-and-the-body}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for grey and spicy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a thumb, a fingernail, the chest, the waist, an eyebrow
  \item a table, a window, a mirror, a television, a computer
  \item a rupee, a bottle, a pocket, socks, a coat
  \item a lotus, wheat, a boat, tears, a moustache
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A thumb? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೆಬ್ಬೆರಳು}}, \emph{hebberaḷu}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\kn{ಉಗುರು}}, \emph{uguru}.) The chest? (\textbf{\kn{ಎದೆ}}, \emph{ede}.) The waist? (\textbf{\kn{ಸೊಂಟ}}, \emph{soṇṭa}.) An eyebrow? (\textbf{\kn{ಹುಬ್ಬು}}, \emph{hubbu}.) A table? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೇಜು}}, \emph{mēju}.) A window? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಿಟಕಿ}}, \emph{kiṭaki}.) A mirror? (\textbf{\kn{ಕನ್ನಡಿ}}, \emph{kannaḍi}.) A television? (\textbf{\kn{ಟೀವಿ}}, \emph{ṭīvi}.) A computer? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್}}, \emph{kampyūṭar}.) A rupee? (\textbf{\kn{ರೂಪಾಯಿ}}, \emph{rūpāyi}.) A bottle? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಾಟಲಿ}}, \emph{bāṭali}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\kn{ಜೇಬು}}, \emph{jēbu}.) Socks? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಕ್ಸ್}}, \emph{sāks}.) A coat? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೋಟು}}, \emph{kōṭu}.) A lotus? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಮಲ}}, \emph{kamala}.) Wheat? (\textbf{\kn{ಗೋಧಿ}}, \emph{gōdhi}.) A boat? (\textbf{\kn{ದೋಣಿ}}, \emph{dōṇi}.) Tears? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಣ್ಣೀರು}}, \emph{kaṇṇīru}.) A moustache? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೀಸೆ}}, \emph{mīse}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{The body and describing words — a second pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R144-second-pass-the-body-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a beard and a foot.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a beard, a foot, long, short, heavy
  \item light, soft, hard, dirty, speed; fast
  \item beautiful, deep; depth, wide, narrow, wet
  \item dry, poor, rich, famous, safe
  \item dangerous, a lie; false, purple, grey, spicy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A beard? (\textbf{\kn{ಗಡ್ಡ}}, \emph{gaḍḍa}.) A foot? (\textbf{\kn{ಪಾದ}}, \emph{pāda}.) Long? (\textbf{\kn{ಉದ್ದ}}, \emph{udda}.) Short? (\textbf{\kn{ಗಿಡ್ಡ}}, \emph{giḍḍa}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\kn{ಭಾರ}}, \emph{bhāra}.) Light? (\textbf{\kn{ಹಗುರ}}, \emph{hagura}.) Soft? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೃದು}}, \emph{mṛdu}.) Hard? (\textbf{\kn{ಗಟ್ಟಿ}}, \emph{gaṭṭi}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೊಳಕು}}, \emph{koḷaku}.) Speed; fast? (\textbf{\kn{ವೇಗ}}, \emph{vēga}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುಂದರ}}, \emph{sundara}.) Deep; depth? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಳ}}, \emph{āḷa}.) Wide? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಗಲ}}, \emph{agala}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಿರಿದು}}, \emph{kiridu}.) Wet? (\textbf{\kn{ಒದ್ದೆ}}, \emph{odde}.) Dry? (\textbf{\kn{ಒಣ}}, \emph{oṇa}.) Poor? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಡ}}, \emph{baḍa}.) Rich? (\textbf{\kn{ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ}}, \emph{śrīmanta}.) Famous? (\textbf{\kn{ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ}}, \emph{prasiddha}.) Safe? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ}}, \emph{surakṣita}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿ}}, \emph{apāyakāri}.) A lie; false? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುಳ್ಳು}}, \emph{suḷḷu}.) Purple? (\textbf{\kn{ನೇರಳೆ}}, \emph{nēraḷe}.) Grey? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೂದು}}, \emph{būdu}.) Spicy? (\textbf{\kn{ಖಾರ}}, \emph{khāra}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
